title: A/P Detail: the Vendor menu ticks several vendors and the chip counts them
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have two vendors, vendor A and vendor B, with open bills on today's date; vendor B's name is longer than the chip can show.
  • Make sure the organization has more than 8 vendors (the Vendor menu shows its search box only when there are more than 8 vendors).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Click the Vendor chip and read the menu from top to bottom.
  2. Type part of vendor B's name in the search box.
  3. Tick vendor B.
  4. Search for vendor A.
  5. Tick vendor A.
  6. Expand every group.
  7. In the Vendor filter, untick both vendors.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens with a search box whose placeholder reads "Search vendors", an "All vendors" row, the line "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow." and the list of vendors.

Step 2:

  • Vendor B shows in the list.

Step 3:

  • Vendor B is ticked.
  • The chip reads "Vendor: " and vendor B's name, shortened with "..." because it is long.

Step 4:

  • Vendor A shows in the list.

Step 5:

  • Vendor A is ticked as well.
  • The chip reads "Vendor: 2 vendors".

Step 6:

  • Only the two vendors' rows remain.

Step 7:

  • No vendor is ticked.
  • The chip reads "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style.

The Vendor chip is the one Inventory Value uses: with one name ticked it reads "Vendor: " and that name, shortened with "..." when the name is long.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). The design's own words:

  • "As of, Customer (Vendor on A/P), Past due, Location. "Customer: All customers" and "Past due: Any" rest grey, Past due with the design system’s hourglass icon. S5-R1, S5-R13, S5-R15." (caption of "Four chips on every report")
  • "Vendor chip with the truck icon, as on Inventory Value. Its menu: a search box, "All vendors" ticked, "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then the vendors. S5-R13, S5-R14." (caption of "The native Vendor menu")
  • "Customer menu with 10 Trucking and 4 Star Truck Repair ticked ("2 selected", shown as tags in the search box): the chip reads "Customer: 2 customers", and rows and Totals narrow to them (4 Star Truck Repair has nothing open). S5-R13, S5-R14, S5-R19." (caption of "Two customers ticked")

Difference from the PRD (DD-02), closed: PRD version 5 said Vendor "exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors")" (S5-R13); the design shows the Vendor menu's search box reads "Search vendor" (singular); alt text: "Search vendor, All vendors and the helper line". PRD version 9 (23 Oct 2026), written after question 12, keeps "Search vendors" and adds that the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors (S5-R13); the singular "Search vendor" in the picture is not the requirement (Chris Ward's sheet row for question 12 repeats question 14's subject; PRD version 9 settles it).
